purpose: Select and screen a mechanics-preserving optimization that can improve at least two representative non-follower workloads before repeating the formal representative qualification.

authority.execution: approved in the active task on 2026-09-20
authority.product_implementation: approved after this diagnostic gate selects an eligible hotspot
authority.promotion: not authorized by this gate; the existing formal representative acceptance remains controlling

execution.acceleration: installed default with nonlinear acceleration initialized before warmup
execution.timing_use: diagnostic attribution only; profiled wall time is not formal performance evidence

hotspot_selection.eligible_if: a production function or coherent call path accounts for at least 5% of profiled solve wall time in each of two non-follower cases, or at least 10% of the combined large-deflection and plastic profiled wall time and is present in one additional non-follower case
hotspot_selection.ranking: prefer shared leaf self-time and repeated setup, projection, assembly, state-copy, or validation work that can be removed without changing physical evaluation count
ineligible_changes: reduced physical evaluation count without an existing equivalence guard

implementation_screen.advance_if: at least two non-follower cases each improve by 5% or more, or the four-case aggregate complete-route time improves by 5% or more, with no case regression beyond 5% and all physical/work predicates passing
implementation_screen.smaller_gain_policy: a smaller repeatable gain may be retained only as an explicitly reported component of a combined candidate; it does not advance alone
